description: This file defines storage schema migration logic for etcd, including migration plans, steps, and version handling.

classes.name: migrationStep
classes.description: Represents a single migration step between two minor versions of etcd storage.

methods.name: newPlan
methods.description: Creates a migration plan from current to target version, supporting only same-major version upgrades/downgrades.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the migration plan using a batch transaction.

methods.name: unsafeExecute
methods.description: Performs the migration steps in an unsafe, non-thread-safe manner.

methods.name: newMigrationStep
methods.description: Creates a migration step for a specific version change, determining actions for upgrade or downgrade.

methods.name: unsafeExecute
methods.description: Executes actions for a migration step and updates storage version if applicable.

methods.name: trimToMinor
methods.description: Trims a semantic version to its major and minor components.
